author: session_research_branch
hypothesis: 截面交互信号(概念共享信息)真实存在:股票 i 的基线残差可由其所属概念组(9 个类别特征各自定义的分组,HIST 式预定义概念)的近期历史平均残差预测。若组级残差动量在四窗口稳定为正并优于 shuffled 负对照,才允许考虑训练截面注意力专家(方案 C 第二阶段,需用户另行授权);否则关闭截面交互路线。
mechanism: per-section t, for each categorical feature k and value v: R_kv(t) = mean over trailing W sections s<t of [mean residual of group (k,v) members at s], z-scored across groups present at t; signal_i = mean_k z_{k,v_k(i)}(t); candidate = (1-alpha)*rank01(base) + alpha*rank01(signal)

distinction_from_rejected_routes.exp028a_entity_axis: exp028a 是个股身份残差(每股一组,收缩系数过强被线上否决);本诊断是概念组聚合残差(每组约 165-440 只股票,噪声结构不同),且零训练、无矩估计
distinction_from_rejected_routes.exp024b_feature_axis: exp024b 检索的是历史截面的特征-标签指纹(哪些特征此刻有效);本诊断是组级残差动量(哪些组近期被系统性低/高估),机制不同
distinction_from_rejected_routes.exp029a_exposure_axis: exp029a 扣除特征暴露;本诊断加入组残差历史信号

preregistered_parameters.group_sources: tree categorical columns 408-416 (9 features, per-section membership from X(t), causal)
preregistered_parameters.nan_category_policy: stock contributes 0 signal from that column when its category is non-finite
preregistered_parameters.negative_control: shuffled: same signal values permuted across stocks within each section (seeded), same alpha blending
preregistered_parameters.selection_rule: choose (alpha, W) maximizing pooled fold2+fold3 mean delta subject to fold2>0, fold3>0, min rank corr>=0.995 on both folds, worst 32-section block>=-0.002 on both folds, momentum pooled > shuffled pooled on fold2+fold3
preregistered_parameters.holdout: official valid [2918,3161) evaluated once with frozen parameters

baseline_note: fold windows use exp016 static strict-OOF proxy on capped 1024-row samples (same as exp024a/029a); official valid uses frozen exp021 full valid prediction; valid-window history mixes train OOF proxy residuals [1459,2918) and valid residuals [2918,t), all labels s<t
stop_rules: 任何门槛失败即终止,不生成 Test 预测、不训练注意力专家
不以扩大网格、更换分组来源、加权历史或 decay 复活
official valid 不用于参数选择,只做冻结参数单次保留验证
若全部通过,训练第二阶段仍需用户明确授权,本轮不自动执行

compliance.no_future_features: 组隶属取自 X(t) 当截面;残差历史只用 s<t 的标签与严格 OOF/冻结预测
compliance.test_labels: 不加载 Test 标签,不生成 prediction

expected_outcome_if_true: 组残差动量四窗口稳定为正且优于 shuffled,开启截面注意力专家训练的用户决策点
expected_outcome_if_false: 概念组残差在组级也不可迁移,截面交互路线随实体轴(exp028a)一并关闭,创新搜索转向方案 B(因子挖掘)或停手
